protocol._comment: V4 protocol. Written 2026-10-18 BEFORE any V4 presence model was trained or scored. Do not edit after results exist; create a new protocol version instead.

signal_contract.model_input: float32[32,60] relative fluctuation + bool[60] gap mask (V3 contract)

timestamp_rules.spike_rule: drop a packet whose timestamp differs from the rolling median of its 5 neighbours by more than spike_s
timestamp_rules.duplicates: kept; packets in the same 1/20 s bin are averaged (V3 grid)

window_quality.rule: a window is VALID only if its longest run of empty grid steps is <= max_interpolated_gap_s AND its missing ratio <= max_missing_ratio. Invalid windows are never used for training and are reported as 'unknown / low quality', never scored as empty or occupied.

labels.rule: any label not listed raises an error; sleep/work and zones are NOT mapped to static/moving

splits.rule: splits are assigned per recording BEFORE windowing; windows never cross recordings
splits.espectre: use the dataset's own dataset_role: train -> train, selection -> val, holdout -> test, exclude -> unused
splits.pipeline: room1_quiet -> train; room1_noisy -> test (recorded congested channel); room2_quiet -> test (unseen room)
splits.homeoccupancy: _1 -> train, _2 -> val, _3 -> test_dev (already inspected in preliminary V4; development benchmark only)
splits.officelocalization: published split: _1 -> train, _2 -> test_external; unlisted empty_3 -> val; unlisted empty_4, empty_5 -> test_extra_empty (false-alarm-only check)

calibration.reference: first 30 s of VALID windows of the first empty recording of the same site within the same split

sites.homeoccupancy: recording index (empty_i calibrates sleep_i and work_i): CROSS-RECORDING reference
sites.officelocalization: split (first empty recording of the split): CROSS-RECORDING reference

calibration.uses_test_labels: only the operational fact that the reference recording is empty (installer knowledge); no labels of scored windows

training.sample_weighting: each source has equal total weight; within a source each class has equal weight; within a source-class each recording has equal weight
training.early_stopping: pick the epoch with the best validation balanced accuracy (patience 5); test data never used
training.decision_threshold: chosen on the validation split to maximise balanced accuracy; 0.5 also reported
training.smoothing: causal rolling median over 5 windows within a recording (V3)
training.transformer_init: V3/models/transformer_pretrained.pt (self-supervised on WiGesture + WiFall only; not trained on any evaluation source)
training.identifier_features: never used: room, recording, session, MAC, chip, channel, source

counting.data_available: WiCount (one meeting room, ESP32-S3, 0-3 people) and OTH room2 samples (0-3 people, one file each). No real data for 4 or 5 people exists in the project.
counting.rule: counts 4 and 5 are never invented; the model head has 6 outputs but 4/5 are reported as 'no training data'
counting.folds: 3 folds. Counts 1 and 2 (7 and 6 recordings): held-out RECORDINGS. Counts 0 and 3 (one recording each): the recording is cut into 3 equal time blocks and fold k tests block k (weaker evidence, reported separately). Windows crossing a block edge are dropped.
counting.cross_room_check: train on all WiCount, test on OTH room2 (different room and setup)
counting.hyperparameters: fixed in advance (no validation selection): LightGBM V3 settings; CNN 30 epochs
counting.metrics: exact accuracy, MAE, per-class precision/recall, confusion, empty false alarms, over/under-count rates, latency, per-recording results

noise_stress._comment: SYNTHETIC noise applied to the raw amplitude stream before preprocessing. Results are stress tests, not real-world noise evidence.

types.agc_jumps: random gain steps about every 5 s; log-gain std 0.1 / 0.3 / 0.6
types.impulses: 1 / 5 / 10 % of packets get 3-10x spikes on 30 % of subcarriers
types.white_noise: additive Gaussian noise at SNR 25 / 15 / 8 dB
types.fan: periodic multiplicative ripple 1-15 Hz with depth 2 / 5 / 10 % (fan, AC, machines)
types.dead_subcarriers: 10 / 25 / 40 % of subcarriers stuck at a constant
types.crazy: all of the above at level 3 at once

noise_stress.seeds: validation noise uses seed 1000+, test noise uses seed 2000+; training augmentation uses seed 0-999
noise_stress.improvement_selection: robust variants are chosen on the VALIDATION split (clean + noisy); the test split is scored once afterwards

promotion._comment: provisional engineering targets, not product requirements
promotion.evaluation_required: a target-room live capture with contemporaneous empty calibration (NOT available in this run)
promotion.also_required: beat V3 on independent groups for presence without trading away occupied sensitivity
promotion.consequence_if_not_met: V3 stays the deployment baseline; V4 is labelled experimental
